name: Spring Wandering Story
source:
An exceptionally warm spring day prompts the early blooming of cherry blossoms.

A cat's escape facilitates an encounter between an exotic young girl living on the streets and a local boy with roots in the neighborhood.

Springtime, flower streets, and fireworks, the springtime romp is coming to an end, and the young girl's heart is about to unravel ......

[From [url=https://mofengm.itch.io/spring-wandering-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
春日格外温暖，樱花提前绽放。

一只猫的逃跑促成了一个流落街头的异国女孩和一个扎根于附近的当地男孩之间的相遇。

春天，花街，烟花，春天的嬉闹即将结束，少女心即将解开……

[来自[url=https://mofengm.itch.io/spring-wandering-story]itch.io[/url]]
